deploy.content: what is esp in networking

esp stands for encapsulating security payload, and it is the part of the ipsec suite that actually protects the traffic. it gives you confidentiality by encrypting the payload of the ip packet, and integrity and authenticity through a message authentication code, so the receiver can tell both that nobody read it and that nobody altered it in transit. you see it most often behind vpns, where it is doing the heavy lifting for site to site tunnels. the spec itself is rfc 4303 if you want the exact field layout.
